description: Create a branded rate-email campaign: on a cadence, email the campaign's recipient list the latest rates for one or more states (or a named region preset) under the org's branding, with ONE OR MORE products (1-5, no duplicates). Each product is one of: {category:'mortgage', subtype:'30-year-fixed'|'15-year-fixed'}, {category:'auto', condition:'new'|'used'|'any', term_months?:36|48|60|72|84} (auto = cars only), or {category:'rv'|'boat'|'motorcycle', condition:'new'|'used'|'any'}. Defaults to a single 30-year-fixed mortgage if products is omitted. Created 'paused'; add recipients, then activate via update_email_campaign (activation requires branding display_name + business_address). Requires a Pro plan. Provide exactly one of state_code, state_codes, or region.

intro_text_override.description: Per-campaign intro; falls back to branding intro_text.

products.description: 1-5 products to feature (no duplicates). Each is {category:'mortgage', subtype:'30-year-fixed'|'15-year-fixed'}, {category:'auto', condition:'new'|'used'|'any', term_months?:36|48|60|72|84}, or {category:'rv'|'boat'|'motorcycle', condition:'new'|'used'|'any'}.

region.description: Named region preset (e.g. east_coast); expands server-side to its member states.

state_code.description: Legacy single 2-letter US state code (e.g. CA). Prefer state_codes or region for multi-state coverage.

state_codes.description: 2-letter US state codes (up to 25) — best rates are ranked ACROSS all of them, not per state.

name: create_email_campaign

outputSchema.description: The created branded rate-email campaign. Requires a Pro (tier 2+) organization.

amount.description: Loan amount used when pricing the featured rates.

id.description: Campaign id (camp_...) — pass to the other campaign tools.

intro_text_override.description: Per-campaign intro, overriding the org default.

last_run_at.description: Epoch-ms of the last send, null if never.

products.description: Parsed list of products the email covers.

region_preset.description: Region preset key when the campaign was scoped by region, else null.

state_code.description: Legacy scalar state — always the first entry of state_codes.

state_codes.description: Full list of two-letter state codes the campaign covers.
